verdict.rationale: Gemini in Gmail can organize the inbox on request, such as adding labels or deleting multiple emails (gmail-docs-14), and can summarize long threads (gmail-docs-13). Automatic labeling comes from user-defined filter rules that match on sender, subject or size (gmail-docs-15, gmail-docs-28), which you can steer but which are deterministic rules rather than AI triage. Missing for 10: autonomous AI auto-labeling/categorization of incoming mail, AI surfacing of what needs attention, an audit trail or explanation of AI triage actions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
